verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers AI-agent automation via its MCP server (query transactions, export CSV, pull statements) and one-click sync of transactions to QuickBooks/NetSuite/Xero, which can accelerate reconciliation and data prep for close. However, there is no explicit evidence of month-end close automation, journal entries, accruals, or a 'faster close' workflow — the automations are framed around expense/spend management, not the accounting close process itself. Missing for 10: explicit close-cycle automation (accruals, journal entries, reconciliation matching), evidence of close-time reduction, and integration depth beyond transaction export/sync.
